summary: This snippet blocks all requests that don't match common static file extensions like images, stylesheets, and fonts. It's a security measure that denies access to any URL that doesn't end with one of the explicitly allowed file types.

explanations.1: RewriteCond is a condition checker: it examines if the requested filename does NOT match the pattern (the ! means 'not'). The pattern lists allowed file extensions like .css, .jpg, .png, etc. Only requests that don't end with these extensions will proceed to the next rule.
explanations.2: RewriteRule . - [F] says: for any request (.), do nothing (-), but apply the [F] flag which means 'forbidden' — essentially rejecting the request with a 403 error.
